tweets.title: In addition to that, P-8Is are classified as strategic assets. These drones, along with the P-8Is, provide us with much-needed ISR capabilities on the LAC as well. I think @VishnuNDTV is just not writing about their true capabilities. These platforms were of tremendous help in identifying the sudden movements of the PAF on a different frontier during and after Op Sindoor. These drones, working in synergy with other systems, are what keep vast areas under surveillance. Lastly, the Navy should be the last force to be accused of anything shady; they are among the most sincere promoters of indigenous technology. I would rather like to discuss how we can develop this technology in record time.
tweets.content:
In addition to that, P-8Is are classified as strategic assets. These drones, along with the P-8Is, provide us with much-needed ISR capabilities on the LAC as well.

I think @VishnuNDTV is just not writing about their true capabilities.

These platforms were of tremendous help in identifying the sudden movements of the PAF on a different frontier during and after Op Sindoor.

These drones, working in synergy with other systems, are what keep vast areas under surveillance.

Lastly, the Navy should be the last force to be accused of anything shady; they are among the most sincere promoters of indigenous technology.

I would rather like to discuss how we can develop this technology in record time.

Vishnu Som (@VishnuNDTV)

➡️Our armchair defence commentariat is sometimes our biggest enemy.
➡️Dislike America all you want but whether you like it or not, the C-17, P-8, MH-60, Apache, the GE-404/414 and a host of other systems bring us capability that our armed forces cannot do without. Its as simple as that.
➡️I didn't need a `state sponsored American promotional press release copy' to know the Sea and Sky Guardian drones being inducted in numbers bring transformational capabilities into the forces. Neither did I get one.
➡️These drones remain airborne for 30–40 hours at 40,000+ feet — no drone of this class in India's current fleet comes close.
➡️They are armed, not just watching: Built for anti-submarine warfare, over-the-horizon strikes, AWACS applications in the future.
➡️Dual radars which enable over-the-horizon maritime domain awareness — tracking and classifying surface contacts across vast swathes of ocean.
➡️An EO/IR and ELINT suite providing target identification and signals intelligence down to the vessel level.
➡️A sonobuoy-capable ASW kit if incorporated would enable submarine threats.
➡️Demonstrated interoperability with the Indian Navy's P-8I and already integrated into the Navy's broader maritime ISR network. Real-time feeds used for shipping surveillance and exercises.
➡️Yes, combat losses of the MQ-9 platform have been very real - but if you want to play with the big boys, be prepared to spend, accept losses and built war wastage reserves. You don't buy this platform to later ask, `kitni deti hain?'
➡️But go right ahead, Drone On. Spare me the insinuation.
